facts.text: The APT serial port opens at 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, one stop bit and RTS/CTS flow control
Port.create returns a SingleControllerPort unless the serial number starts with 70, 73 or 94, which selects the unimplemented CardSlotPort
SingleControllerPort.get_stages accepts only channel 0x01 and returns a GenericStage for it
A short APT frame is a little-endian 16-bit message id, two parameter bytes, a destination byte and a source byte
The stage position is the encoder count divided by EncCnt
The position setter multiplies the position by EncCnt and sends MGMSG_MOT_MOVE_ABSOLUTE_long
The velocity conversion uses EncCnt and T, with T = 2048 / 6e6
A stage reports mm when its configured Units value is 1 and the degree sign when it is 2
status_homed is status bit 0x00000400 of the APT status word
home_non_blocking sends MGMSG_MOT_MOVE_HOME and returns without waiting for the move to finish
MGMSG_MOT_MOVE_ABSOLUTE_long is message 0x453 with a 16-bit channel and a signed 32-bit position
MGMSG_MOT_MOVE_HOME is message 0x443 with a channel byte
MGMSG_MOT_MOVE_STOP is message 0x465 with a channel byte and a stop mode (0x01 immediately, 0x02 controlled)
MGMSG_MOT_SET_VELPARAMS is message 0x415 and carries min_velocity, acceleration and max_velocity

operator_required.name: max_velocity
operator_required.reason: The usable velocity depends on the installed stage; the upstream code only converts the value and states no bound, so the operator must narrow it for the bench

operator_required.reason: The usable acceleration depends on the installed stage; the upstream code only converts the value and states no bound, so the operator must narrow it for the bench
